input.summary: Remove the Company-payable Termination Payment and confirm no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by the Company.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the Company-payable Termination Payment formula and the related payment mechanics, because our playbook does not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by us. If a termination charge is essential, we could accept one capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) The Company shall not be required to pay to HDI any termination payment, liquidated damages or penalty in respect of any termination of this Agreement.
